<title>Dopynion 2026-11-17T14:39:41.243169+01:00</title><link href="https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/static/main.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>

<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>

<title>Dopynion 2026-11-17T14:39:38.422649+01:00</title><link href="https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/static/main.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {

<title>Dopynion 2026-11-17T14:39:34.272387+01:00</title><link href="https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/static/main.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>

const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {

<title>Dopynion 2026-11-17T14:39:32.540982+01:00</title><link href="https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/static/main.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>

<title>Dopynion 2026-11-17T14:39:31.851256+01:00</title><link href="https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/static/main.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>

<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>

<title>Dopynion 2026-11-17T14:39:28.319702+01:00</title><link href="https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/static/main.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }

<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>

<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>

<title>Dopynion 2026-11-17T14:39:25.420340+01:00</title><link href="https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/static/main.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>

<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>

<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>

<title>Dopynion 2026-11-17T14:39:23.001249+01:00</title><link href="https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/static/main.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script>
const GAME_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("dop-game-data").textContent);
const IMAGE_PREFIX = "https://dopynion.lecalamar.fr/";
const CARD_SET_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cs;
const CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME = GAME_DATA.cn;

if (!customElements.get("dop-card")) {
  customElements.define("dop-card", class extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() {
      const cardSet = this.getAttribute("set");
      const cardName = this.getAttribute("name");
      const qty = Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute("qty") || "1", 10);
      const quantity = Number.isNaN(qty) ? 1 : Math.max(1, qty);
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i += 1) {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "card";
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.src = IMAGE_PREFIX + "static/img/cards.fr/" + cardSet + "/" + cardName + ".jpg";
        card.appendChild(img);
        fragment.appendChild(card);
      }
      this.replaceWith(fragment);
    }
  });
}

const renderGame = () => {
  const root = document.getElementById("game-root");
  const turnNos = {};
  let lastDisplayedTurn = 0;

  const createHeading = (level, text) => {
    const heading = document.createElement(level);
    heading.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(heading);
  };

  const appendParagraph = (text) => {
    const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
    paragraph.textContent = text;
    root.appendChild(paragraph);
  };

  const appendCard = (parent, cardName, quantity = 1) => {
    const card = document.createElement("dop-card");
    card.setAttribute("set", CARD_SET_BY_NAME[cardName]);
    card.setAttribute("name", cardName);
    card.setAttribute("qty", String(quantity));
    parent.appendChild(card);
  };

  const appendCards = (cards, stacked = false) => {
    const cardsContainer = document.createElement("div");
    cardsContainer.className = "cards";
    for (const [cardName, quantity] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      if (stacked) {
        const deck = document.createElement("div");
        deck.className = "deck";
        appendCard(deck, cardName, quantity);
        cardsContainer.appendChild(deck);
      } else {
        appendCard(cardsContainer, cardName, quantity);
      }
    }
    root.appendChild(cardsContainer);
  };

  const titleCaseWords = (text) => text
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(" ")
    .map((word) => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word)
    .join(" ");

  createHeading("h1", "Partie du " + GAME_DATA.date);
  createHeading("h2", "Réserve initiale");
  appendCards(GAME_DATA.stock, true);

  for (const turn of GAME_DATA.turns) {
    turnNos[turn.p] = (turnNos[turn.p] || 0) + 1;
    const turnNo = Math.max(...Object.values(turnNos));
    if (turnNo !== lastDisplayedTurn) {
      root.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
    }
    lastDisplayedTurn = turnNo;
    const playerName = GAME_DATA.players[turn.p];
    createHeading("h2", "Tour " + turnNo + " : " + playerName);

    for (const action of turn.a) {
      if (["B", "A", "E", "O"].includes(action.t)) {
        let title = "Action";
        if (action.t === "B") {
          title = "Achète " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          title = "Joue " + (CARD_LABEL_BY_NAME[action.c] || action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          title = "Fin Du Tour";
        } else {
          title = titleCaseWords(action.r || "action");
        }
        createHeading("h3", title);
        if (action.h && Object.keys(action.h).length > 0) {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a ces cartes :");
          appendCards(action.h);
        }
        if (action.t === "B") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " achète");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "A") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " joue");
          appendCard(root, action.c);
        } else if (action.t === "E") {
          appendParagraph(playerName + " a pour l'instant un score de " + action.s);
        }
      } else if (action.t === "X") {
        const errorBlock = document.createElement("div");
        errorBlock.className = action.k || "error";
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        const title = document.createElement("p");
        title.textContent = "Erreur de " + who;
        errorBlock.appendChild(title);
        const details = document.createElement("p");
        details.textContent = action.e;
        errorBlock.appendChild(details);
        root.appendChild(errorBlock);
      } else if (action.t === "H") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        createHeading("h3", who + ": " + action.n);
        appendParagraph(action.g);
      } else if (action.t === "R") {
        const who = GAME_DATA.players[action.p] || playerName;
        appendParagraph(who + " a répondu " + action.r);
      }
    }
  }

  createHeading("h2", "Score");
  const scoreList = document.createElement("ul");
  for (let i = 0; i < GAME_DATA.players.length; i += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = GAME_DATA.players[i] + " a un score de " + GAME_DATA.scores[i];
    scoreList.appendChild(item);
  }
  root.appendChild(scoreList);
};

if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderGame);
} else {
  renderGame();
}
</script>
